references.text: The original instruction from God regarding the five crossbars for the boards on the other side of the tabernacle and toward the back to the west. Exodus 36:32 describes the execution of this command.
The complete description of God's command concerning the crossbars for the tabernacle's boards, which Moses and the craftsmen followed in its construction.
The preceding verse that describes the five crossbars for the boards on one side of the tabernacle, providing the context for verse 32.
The following verse that describes the middle crossbar that ran through all the boards from end to end, completing the description of the crossbar system.
